verdict.rationale: Sprinto's own docs claim continuous monitoring with alerts, so alerting on monitored compliance posture is a first-party capability, but the evidence is a single marketing-level line. The ClickUp and Jira integrations appear to be ticketing systems connected for change-management checks, not channels for routing control-failure alerts. The webhooks are inbound-only, and the status-page emails cover Sprinto's own incidents, so neither counts. missing for 10: documented delivery of control-failure/drift alerts to Slack, email alerts for failing controls, auto-creation of tickets from findings, evidence of remediation context in alerts, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, control failures and configuration drift alert me where I work — Slack, email, or ticketing — with enough context to fix the finding

citations.quote: Maintain readiness with continuous monitoring, alerts, and evidence collection.
integrating with your existing cloud stack, continuously monitoring your systems
